preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 1000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in string s must be lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'impossible' if len(set(s)) + (len(s) - len(set(s))) < k else True
postconditions.description: If the number of unique characters in s plus the number of changes needed is less than k, output 'impossible'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max(0, k - len(set(s)))) if len(set(s)) + (len(s) - len(set(s))) >= k else True
postconditions.description: If it is possible to achieve k different letters, output the minimum number of changes required.
